<a id="corner_anim_ptrs"></a>
### [`corner_anim_ptrs`](../../../../src/graphics/corner_anims.asm#L6) `$BC7D-$BC84`

*data*

Pointers to the 4 corner animations. $81c1 plays animation n when $5b,x holds $80+n.

- **Read by:** [`animate_corner`](../screen/corner_anim.md#animate_corner)

<a id="corner_anim_0"></a>
### [`corner_anim_0`](../../../../src/graphics/corner_anims.asm#L9) `$BC85-$BC8E`

*data*

Corner animation: column, row, width and height in cells, then frame addresses. A word below 4 is a command. Commands: 0 restarts, 1 jumps to the offset that follows, 2 starts the animation that follows, 3 stops.

- **Entry of:** [`corner_anim_ptrs`](../../tables.md#corner_anim_ptrs)
